info.title: ClubOS API
info.description:
Backend for ClubOS, the all-in-one club management platform for SBU student organizations. 25Live, SB Engaged and NXT data is SIMULATED for the demo.

Try it: click **Authorize**, log in as `sarah@sbu.clubos`, then call any endpoint.

post.summary: Log in with email + password (use this from React)
Same as /login but form-encoded (powers the Authorize button in /docs)

get.summary: Who am I + which clubs I'm on
Clubs I'm on (for the club switcher)
Club profile + my position in it
The home screen in one call: stats, upcoming events, tasks, approvals, budget, activity

post.summary: Create Event

get.summary: EVERYTHING about one event in one call (tasks, approvals, money, vendors, chat, emails)

post.summary: Attach a vendor to an event (or update its status)

get.summary: List tasks (filter by event, assignee, status, or just mine)

post.summary: Create a task

patch.summary: Update a task (assign, change status, priority, deadline...)

get.summary: Channels with message counts and the latest message
Messages, oldest first. Pass after_id to fetch only new ones (polling).

post.summary: Send Message
Turn a chat message into a task (ClubOS posts a confirmation in the channel)

get.summary: Approvals center: every event with its 25Live, SB Engaged, NXT status + readiness

post.summary: Create a 25Live reservation draft (simulated)
Demo button: advance to the next status
Tick / untick a required document
Demo button: advance to the next status

get.summary: Budget overview: totals, per-category planned/spent, recent expenses, requests

post.summary: Add an expense (President/Treasurer). Returns the expense AND the updated budget.
Create a financial request draft (President/Treasurer)
Demo button: advance to the next status

get.summary: Vendors (sample data, not verified SBU-approved businesses)

post.summary: Create Vendor
Fill a template from an event's data. Returns to/subject/body + mailto link.
AI button: rewrite subject + body in a chosen tone (Gemini)
Build a mailto: link for any to/subject/body (after the user edits it)
Save a draft

get.summary: Is the AI configured? (frontend can hide/disable AI buttons)

post.summary: Talk to the agent. Returns its reply + proposed changes (confirm cards) + email drafts
User clicked ✅ on a proposal: apply it
User clicked ❌ on a proposal
Wipe everything and reload the demo data
